headline: RGE Indonesian Pulp Unit Defends Operations After Forestry Licence Revoked
summary: RGE's Indonesian pulp and paper division defended its legal compliance following state revocation of its forestry licence, warning that local employment and supply chains are threatened.
why: RGE is a major global natural resources producer, and regulatory licence revocations in Indonesia disrupt global paper supply chains.

impacts.name: Royal Golden Eagle
impacts.why: Forestry licence cancellation jeopardizes raw material extraction and operational capability.
